name: Note
summary:
The Note App is a simple yet powerful 2D application designed for Meta Quest 2 and 3. It allows users to efficiently manage their notes in a virtual reality environment. Whether you need to jot down ideas, organize tasks, or keep track of important information, this app has you covered.

# Key Features
- Create Notes Quickly add new notes with a user-friendly interface.
